gloss: the very last; dead last; tail end

definitions.gloss: the very last; dead last; tail end
definitions.explanation: An emphatic, informal word meaning the absolute last position or the very end of a line, race, or ranking. More emphatic than simply {最後|さいご}.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧どん{尻|じり}だった。
examples.english: I came in dead last in the marathon.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧どん{尻|じり}だ。
examples.english: That team is always in last place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どん{尻|じり}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: My grades were dead last, so I started studying desperately.

notes:
USAGE:
An informal, emphatic expression. The prefix どん adds emphasis, similar to how it works in ⟦どん{底|ぞこ}→どん底：08781_donzoko⟧ (rock bottom). Often used in sports, rankings, and competitive contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どん{尻|じり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end up dead last)
- どん{尻|じり}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{数|かぞ}えた→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (easier to count from the bottom)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最下位|さいかい}→最下位：20709_saikai⟧: last place — a more formal, neutral expression
- ⟦びり→ビリ：23005_biri⟧: last place — a casual synonym
- ⟦どん{底|ぞこ}→どん底：08781_donzoko⟧: rock bottom — the same emphatic prefix applied to "bottom"
